Class TreeElement<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.toolkit.element.StyledElement<TreeElement<T>>
dev.tamboui.toolkit.elements.TreeElement<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of data associated with tree nodes
All Implemented Interfaces:
Styleable, Element
public final class TreeElement<T> extends StyledElement<TreeElement<T>>
A scrollable, keyboard-navigable hierarchical tree view.

The tree flattens visible nodes (only expanded branches) into a list for rendering, with guide characters showing the hierarchy. 

tree(
    TreeNode.of("src",
        TreeNode.of("main"),
        TreeNode.of("test")
    ).expanded(),
    TreeNode.of("README.md").leaf()
).title("Project")
 .rounded()
 .highlightColor(Color.CYAN)

CSS Child Selectors

  • TreeElement-node - styles each tree node
  • TreeElement-node:selected - styles the selected node
  • TreeElement-guide - styles the guide/branch characters
  • TreeElement-scrollbar-thumb - styles the scrollbar thumb
  • TreeElement-scrollbar-track - styles the scrollbar track

CSS Properties

  • guide-style - guide character style: "unicode", "ascii", "none"
  • scrollbar-policy - when to show scrollbar: "none", "always", "as-needed"
  • highlight-symbol - symbol shown before selected item (default: "> ")
  • indent-width - space per depth level in cells

Keyboard Navigation

  • Up/Down - move selection
  • Right - expand node or move to first child
  • Left - collapse node or move to parent
  • Enter/Space - toggle expand/collapse
  • Home/End - first/last visible node
  • Page Up/Down - scroll by viewport height

    • nodeRenderer

      public TreeElement<T> nodeRenderer(Function<TreeNode<T>, StyledElement<?>> renderer)
      Sets a custom renderer for tree nodes.

      When set, each node is rendered using the provided function instead of the default label text. This allows for rich node content including icons, colored text, progress bars, or any other styled elements.

      Example: 

      tree(...)
    .nodeRenderer(node -> row(
        text(node.isLeaf() ? "📄 " : "📁 "),
        text(node.label()).bold(),
        spacer(),
        text(formatSize(node.data())).dim()
    ))
      Parameters:
      renderer - the function that converts a tree node to a styled element
      Returns:
      this element for chaining

    • preferredSize

      public Size preferredSize(int availableWidth, int availableHeight, RenderContext context)
      Description copied from interface: Element
      Returns the preferred size of this element.

      The availableWidth/Height parameters allow elements to adapt their dimensions based on constraints. Use -1 for unconstrained.

      Common patterns:

      • Text elements: height depends on width (text wrapping)
      • Aspect-ratio elements: both dimensions interrelated
      • Fixed elements: ignore available dimensions

      Return value semantics:

      • Positive values = known size (use as constraint)
      • Zero = explicitly zero-sized (element should collapse)
      • Negative (-1) = unknown size (element should fill available space)
      Parameters:
      availableWidth - the available width in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      availableHeight - the available height in cells, or -1 if unconstrained
      context - the render context for CSS resolution, may be null
      Returns:
      the preferred size

    • styleAttributes

      public Map<String,String> styleAttributes()
      Description copied from interface: Styleable
      Returns the style attributes for attribute selector matching.

      Attribute selectors like Panel[title="Test"] match elements based on their style attributes. This method returns a map of attribute names to their values.

      Common attributes include:

      • title - the element's title
      • label - the element's label
      • placeholder - the element's placeholder text
